item.title: YAGNI
item.description: You ain't gonna need it!Don't implement stuff just because you foresee a requirement, only do it when you actually need it.

item.title: SRP
item.description: #solid_princliples "A class should have one, and only one reason to change." "A class should have only one stakeholder". "A module should do one job." The change can be requested by only one stakeholder. The God Class A class that tries to do everything. Things that try to do everything do nothing well. Focus on cohesion, not fragmentation. Group logic that changes together or belongs to the same business concern.

item.title: OCP
LSP
LOD
item.description: Law of Demeter : Only talk to your immediate friends.The rule is straightforward. A method M on an object O should only call methods on: Itself (the object O) Its own fields (objects that O holds as instance variables like DI) Its method parameters (objects passed into M) Objects it creates (objects instantiated within M)  don't reach through one object to get to another.If you inject IMyService into your class: Allowed: _myService.DoWork() (Talking to a direct friend). Violation: _myService.Configuration.DatabaseSettings.ConnectionString

item.title: KISS
item.description: Keep it simple stupid.Try to avoid complexity whenever possible, these include overengineering, anticipating requirements and un-necessary requirements.
